# illi

> illi adds mouse gesture controls to YouTube for people who watch to learn or understand. Hold the scroll-wheel button over the player, move to change speed or navigate, and release. Optional right-click activation replaces the native context menu inside the player.

## Supported setup
YouTube in Chrome on a desktop or laptop with a mouse. Do not infer phone, Safari, full keyboard or verified trackpad support from this page.

## Features
- Speed gestures, including up/down adjustment and release-to-set.
- Precise navigation and a mark of the furthest point reached.
- Channel-speed memory and a default for new channels.
- Bookmarks, position adjustment and cross-device sync.
- Optional auto-pause/resume when switching away, with an A hotkey toggle.
- Optional walkthrough and gesture guide.
Bookmark-hover frame previews, transcript export, looping and picture-in-picture are not advertised features here.

## Offer
All prices are USD.
- New accounts created after this offer launches receive full illi Premium for 45 days from signup; account required, no card. Existing unpaid accounts keep their original trial deadlines; they do not receive a restarted or extended trial.
- Basic speed control remains free afterwards. illi Premium features require paid access after the trial.
- Standard illi Premium: $10/month or $100/year.
- Founding offer: choose $40 for one year or $80 for two years at the initial purchase, paid upfront plus applicable tax. Afterwards automatically renews at $100 USD annually plus applicable tax unless cancelled. No separate discounted year can be added later.
- Founding payment is collected at purchase. The selected prepaid term starts after any remaining trial. Checkout shows the first annual renewal date; advance email reminders include a direct cancellation route. Cancellation preserves purchased access, then basic speed stays free.
- One published campaign deadline or 1,000 initial purchasers, whichever comes first. Never infer that the campaign is open: consult the pricing page's current status.
- Starting a trial reserves no founding place.
